##### Abstract

A real toric manifold $X^$ is said to be cohomologically rigid over $_2$ if every real toric manifold whose $_2$-cohomology ring is isomorphic to the one of $X^$ is actually diffeomorphic to $X^$. Not all real toric manifolds are cohomologically rigid over $_2$. In this paper, we prove that the connected sum of three real projective spaces is cohomologically rigid over $_2$.
